provenance.art: Built-in ImageGen (GPT Image), new painting with the existing oak as style reference
provenance.raster_finish: White matte suppression, ratio-preserving downsampling, root pivot and export in Krita 5.3.4.1; residual neutral matte removed with neighboring local foreground colors on translucent pixels. Original layers and identical alpha stored in native Krita masters. Raised celadon flecks through the canopy also receive localized foreground pigment recovery, including fully covered areas with white carryover. Intact warm highlights, untouched visual alpha, and a limited protection mask for naturally pale birch bark. The spruce and birch crown pigments were refined against the realm palette to remove remaining celadon edge marks while keeping alpha and saturated gold intact. Naturally pale birch bark retains its separate mask. Oak raster unchanged in this revision.
provenance.prompt: Three rooted trees: mature spruce, forked white birch, and ancient oak, in Emberfall painterly isometric fantasy style, moss and olive colours, with separated silhouettes and transparent background.
